name: Veselá (Semily District, Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a white upper hoist part bearing a red sun issuing from the upper hoist corner and a green lower fly part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 12 May 2016 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
